WITH RECURSIVE organization_path AS ( SELECT id, pid, name, name::text AS path FROM spectra_core.sys_department WHERE deleted IS NULL AND pid IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT department.id, department.pid, department.name, organization_path.path || '/' || department.name AS path FROM spectra_core.sys_department AS department JOIN organization_path ON organization_path.id = department.pid WHERE department.deleted IS NULL ) UPDATE spectra_core.sys_department AS department SET path = organization_path.path, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = department.version + 1 FROM organization_path WHERE department.id = organization_path.id AND department.deleted IS NULL AND department.path IS DISTINCT FROM organization_path.path
